title: fix(automation): durable http node with no method sends POST via the outbox but GET on the no-outbox fallback
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (found while reviewing in-flight work). Contract review of PR #33482 (card #32525) read `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/http-nodes.ts` on main to judge a skill sentence, and found this outside its diff. The seat confirmed it on main.

## What is wrong

A durable `http` node (`config.durable: true`) authored without `method` sends a different verb depending on whether an outbox is wired:

- **Outbox wired:** the enqueue passes `method: cfg.method ?? 'POST'`.
- **No outbox (the degrade path, awaited or in the background on the save path):** `sendInline` uses `cfg.method ?? 'GET'`.

The node's own descriptor says "Default `GET`; `POST` when `durable` is true", and the file header says the no-outbox fallback "signs exactly as the outbox would have". So the same flow sends POST in one environment and GET in another. A GET also drops the request body and is counted as a read (`reads` is true, so the effect is reported as `0`).

## Fix

In the durable arm, resolve the verb once (`cfg.method ?? (durable ? 'POST' : 'GET')`) and use it on both paths. Add a test: durable, no `method`, no outbox → POST, with the same signed bytes the outbox would send.

## Scope

Behaviour fix in `service-automation`, so a `patch` changeset is owed. No spec change. The skill text in PR #33482 says nothing about the default verb, so it stays true either way.
